verdict.rationale: Loops' own docs include a domain setup step required before sending, and the Brevo migration guide includes a 'verify your domain' step, so first-party sending-domain authentication exists. The pack does not describe SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment, or the guided DNS record workflow. missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC record documentation, guided DNS setup details (records to add, provider instructions), verification status/checking flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification

citations.quote: Set up your domain to start sending email
